content:
Black Friday might technically be over, but the deals continue through the weekend! Nearly all of the best deals and savings we've covered so far are still live, so there is plenty of time to save money at Amazon, Newegg, Best Buy, Walmart, and more.

We're tracking the best deals still live on PC gaming hardware across every category, including CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSDs, gaming laptops, desktops, tools, and more. As always, we make recommendations based on our thousands of hours of hands-on testing, extensive benchmarking database, and price tracking tools to ensure deals are actually deals.

With AI pushing up the price of PC gaming, finding a deal is more difficult, but more important than ever before, so let us do the hard work. Here are the best ongoing Black Friday weekend deals.

Hottest Black Friday Tech Deals

OMEN 35L Gaming Desktop: was $4399.99 now $2699.99
Get an RTX 5080 PC from HP's HyperX gaming brand with Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus, 16GB of RAM, and a 1TB SSD, with plenty of space to upgrade. Also features Wi-Fi 7. View Deal

The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a 14.5-inch display designed to serve as an extension for your desktop and give you a small screen to host your most important apps. Its versatility means you can mount it practically anywhere — horizontally under your main monitor, vertically beside your primary display, or as a digital status panel inside your PC case. View Deal

25-Piece Upgraded Electric Screwdriver Kit: was $49.99 now $28.48
Get a 25-piece electric screwdriver for PC maintenance or any DIY task. Comes with a 1,500mAh battery, LED, and extension rod. View Deal

Apple's base MacBook Neo has an A18 Pro chip, 256GB of storage, and 8GB of RAM. A solid alternative with a more powerful SoC. View Deal

The Dell XPS 13 with an Intel Core 5 320, 8GB of RAM, and 256 GB of storage. View Deal

T-Force G50 Evo M.2 2280 4TB PCIe 4.0 x4: was $485.99 now $399.99
This T-Force G50 Evo offers sequential read speeds of 5,000 MB/s and write speeds of up to 4,800 MB/s. View Deal

Odyssey (G55C) Series QHD 1000R Curved Gaming Monitor: was $329.99 now $180.48
Returning to its lowest-ever price, get a 32-inch curved QHD (2560 x 1440) gaming monitor with a 165Hz refresh rate for just $189, a massive $140 saving. View Deal

External Power Button for Desktop PC: was $13.99 now $11.19
This external power button has a 2-meter (~78 inches) cabl, along with a splitter that lets you connect both to your case's front panel buttons. It also includes adhesive pads and zip ties. View Deal

CD/DVD burner with USB Hub and M.2 Dock: was $49.99 now $39.99
Now with M.2 NVMe SSD dock!

The most expensive of the bunch, this optical CD/DVD writer from SUIDEK upgrades the SATA dock to an M.2 NVMe SSD dock, but keeps the SD card reader, USB-A, and USB-C hub. View Deal

* The listed previous prices can vary based on retailer, as many use different metrics, like 90-day rolling averages or ‘estimated value’ due to ongoing shortages and price hikes.

November 28, 2026 – 2:16 AM Good morning and welcome to Saturday! The team are here to show you all the latest and greatest deals still available at your favorite retailers.

November 28, 2026 – 2:17 AM Black Friday is really now an all-weekend, if not an all-November affair. As such, all the deals we brought you earlier this week and on Friday itself are generally still live. In fact, there are even some fresh deals we haven't seen before!

November 28, 2026 – 2:35 AM Intel's Core Ultra 7 270K Plus hits $249.99, with a free 360mm AIO and two additional games

Intel's Core Ultra 270K plus lives on our list of the best CPUs for gaming for a good reason; not only is it adept at crunching through the latest games, but it's also our top pick for anyone looking for a top-shelf productivity workhorse. Intel's latest and greatest CPU is listed at $269 at Newegg, but it also comes with a stackable code, knocking the price down to $249 with a handful of free gifts: A Rosewill 360mm AIO liquid cooler, in addition to an Intel Gaming Bundle where you can pick from two free titles, including Total War: Warhammer 40,000, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, and more.

Core Ultra 7 270K Plus: was $309.95 now $249.99
Get Intel's latest and greatest processor, the 270K Plus. The 8p/16e core processor has plenty of oomph to plow through any workflow and games well, too. View Deal

Future Future Future The Intel Core Ultra 270K Plus manages to go toe-to-toe in gaming performance with AMD's Ryzen 7 7800X3D, and is one of the best CPUs available now in productivity workloads. Sporting a total of 24 cores, split into 8 P-Cores and 16 E-Cores, the configuration actually matches the same core config as the much pricier Core Ultra 9 285K. Boasting clock speeds of up to 5.5GHz, this is a seasonal offer you don't want to miss out on. — Sayem Ahmed
